chapter: Giving up and returning to music
title: Giving up music in the late 1920s
summary: Music got tough, his last job was in the Irish Channel, and he sold his drums while continuing night work at the bank.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: I see. Yeah. So things had got kind of tough for music and I gave it up for a while. That was back in the 20s. Yeah.
So I gave it up for a long time.
What was the last job you played? Do you remember?
The last job I played was up in the Irish Channel.
That was back in the 20s, late 20s. Well, after that music kind of died down and I gave it up. But I was still doing night work with the National Bank.
